audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Riven, Riven, Skill, Skill, Riven, Riven while the packet chart reads Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Riven - the two stages Olaf owns outright are handed to Riven, and two neutral stages are claimed for her as well.
audit.why: The page's own whys already describe the packet chart: whys[0] says a Level 1 trade 'bleeds your HP bar and powers him up' (Olaf), whys[1] says to 'hold for Level 3 before looking for real trades' (Olaf), whys[2] calls Ragnarok the wild card (Skill), whys[3] says 'genuinely even' in as many words (Skill), and whys[6] says two items in your rotations outdamage him (Riven). A 50.56% lane cannot be a chart Riven owns four ways. The olaf__riven mirror set the same seven values as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Riven, with ratings moved so neutral rows read 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two separate claims about Ragnarok are wrong. whys[4] says your stun 'locks up nothing if he pops it mid-combo', which treats Ragnarok as a cleanse, and the mid prose says it 'burns out its 15-second window'. The Level 6 spike also says 'his axes deal true damage'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ragnarok makes him 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' - immunity to what comes next, not removal of what has already landed, and its duration is tied to him continuing to attack, not to a fixed 15 seconds. The kit file gives no basis for a cleanse claim, so the sequencing flips: land Ki Burst before he presses R, never after. Separately, the true damage is Reckless Swing (E) at 325 range on 11/10/9/8/7s, not Undertow - the axe reduces Armor and Move Speed, which is a different problem entirely and one that armour actually interacts with.
audit.corrected: whys[2], whys[4], the Level 6 spike, the mid prose and wants.foe[1] rewritten to say immunity-to-new-disables and to name Reckless Swing as the true-damage source.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow's axe-retrieval reset is absent from the entire matchup, and the mid prose says you can 'Q-chain through him while he is grounded' when nothing in either kit grounds anybody.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.' That is the single most important tempo fact of the lane - the nominal 9s cooldown is only real if he cannot walk over the axe, so where you stand relative to a thrown axe decides whether the slow is intermittent or permanent. Separately the kit file tags Undertow with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's description says only that it reduces Armor and Move Speed; per the description-beats-flag rule I wrote no grounding claim, and removed the existing one.
audit.corrected: Axe reset written into whys[1], the Level 1-2 spike and the early prose; the grounding sentence removed from the mid prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing notes that Ragnarok also gives him resistances passively.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist.' That is a permanent stat line from level 6 onward, not something he has to press, so flat AD scaling into him decays over the game and armour reduction is worth more than raw damage.

edits.before: Olaf's axes slow on hit and his passive gives attack-speed as he loses HP — a Level 1 extended trade without your W stun online bleeds your HP bar and powers him up simultaneously.
edits.after: Undertow slows and shreds armour while Berserker Rage feeds him attack speed as he drops — a Level 1 extended trade without Ki Burst online bleeds you and powers him up at once.

edits.before: Olaf's sustained axe DPS through the Level 2 slow still outdamages your Q-W rotation unless you immediately disengage after the stun — hold for Level 3 before looking for real trades.
edits.after: He walks over the thrown axe to reset Undertow outright, so the slow is near-permanent if you stand on it — hold for Level 3 and Valor before you look for any real trade.

edits.before: Full kit online but Ragnarok is the wild card — bait his R with a fake E commit, then re-engage with W-stun into full Q-chain the moment R's window begins to expire.
edits.after: Full kit online but Ragnarok is the wild card — it blocks new disables while he keeps attacking, so bait it with a fake Valor commit and save Ki Burst until it lapses.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extends your range and Wind Slash executes below half HP — but Ragnarok's CC-immunity means your W locks up nothing if he pops it mid-combo; bait it first.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile extends your range and Wind Slash executes below half HP — but Ragnarok blocks any stun cast after it, so land Ki Burst before he presses R, never after.

edits.before: Olaf's axes slow you and his passive gives him bonus attack speed as he loses HP — he is at his most dangerous when you are both low early.
edits.after: Undertow slows and cuts your armour, and picking the axe back up resets its 9s cooldown — never fight standing on top of an axe he can walk over.

edits.before: Olaf's Ragnarok makes him CC-immune and his axes deal true damage — your W stun does nothing against it; bait R before all-ins.
edits.after: Ragnarok blocks disables while he attacks, and Reckless Swing (E) is the true damage, on 7-11s — land Ki Burst before he presses R.

edits.before: Level 1 is Olaf's lane. His axes slow you on top of his passive attack-speed scaling as his HP drops — if you take an extended Level 1 trade you are fighting a man who gets faster and hits harder while bleeding, and your W is not yet online to interrupt it. Sit on the edge of Q range and last-hit; if he pitches an axe into you, take the chip damage and do not chase into melee. At Level 2 he still edges it because his sustained DPS beats your two-ability rotation unless you immediately disengage after Q-W. Do not look for kills here — just get to Level 3 with your HP bar intact.
edits.after: Level 1 is Olaf's lane. Undertow slows you and strips armour on top of Berserker Rage scaling his attack speed as his HP drops — take an extended Level 1 trade and you fight a man who gets faster and hits harder while bleeding, with no Ki Burst yet to interrupt him. Sit at the edge of Broken Wings range and last-hit; when he pitches an axe, step off it rather than chasing, because walking over it resets Undertow outright. At Level 2 he still edges it: his sustained damage beats a two-ability rotation unless you disengage instantly. Reach Level 3 with your HP bar intact.

edits.before: Level 3 is when the lane becomes genuinely even. Your full Q-W-E kit lets you open with E shield into W-stun, then Q-chain through him while he is grounded — but Ragnarok is the variable that flips every calculation. Track his R cooldown the same way you track flash. When it is down, you can trade freely; when it is up, bait it with a short E-Q poke and disengage, then re-engage the moment it activates and burns out its 15-second window. His R makes him CC-immune, not unkillable — your passive-empowered autos and Q chain still deal full damage into it, but your W stun does nothing, so time your W for after R expires if the trade goes long enough. At Level 6 your Wind Slash execute is the great equaliser: if a Ragnarok all-in runs him below half HP, the execute range means he cannot walk away.
edits.after: Level 3 is when the lane becomes genuinely even. Your full kit lets you open with Valor into Ki Burst and run Broken Wings through him — but Ragnarok is the variable that flips every calculation. Track it the way you track Flash: 100 seconds at rank 1. When it is down you trade freely; when it is up, bait it with a short poke and disengage. Ragnarok blocks disables for as long as he keeps attacking, not damage — Runic Blade autos and Broken Wings still land in full, but a Ki Burst cast after he presses R does nothing, so stun first or hold it. It also gives him armour and magic resist passively, so Black Cleaver beats stacking raw AD. At Level 6 Wind Slash is the equaliser: run him below half HP and the execute range means he cannot walk away.

edits.before: Win Slash-execute him through his lifesteal — fight at range the moment he drops below half HP
edits.after: Wind Slash him through his lifesteal — fight at range the moment he drops below half HP

edits.before: Spam axes to slow you, proc his passive attack-speed buff, and brute-force DPS through your E shield
edits.after: Throw Undertow, walk over it to reset the cooldown, and grind damage through Valor as Berserker Rage climbs

edits.before: Activate Ragnarok the instant he sees your W animation so your stun lands but your combo has no lockdown
edits.after: Press Ragnarok before your Ki Burst goes out, so the stun never lands and your combo has no lockdown at all

notes: PACKET DEFECT confirmed from this side too: the brief's top-level games is 977 while packet.games is 958, and the olaf__riven mirror recorded the same mismatch. Someone should decide which figure the page cites. The 'Ragnarok cleanses your stun' framing appeared here as it did in the mirror; Ragnarok grants immunity to disables while he keeps attacking, which makes the sequencing 'stun before he presses R' rather than 'bait then stun', and I did not assert anything about whether it also covers Broken Wings' third-cast knockback, because the kit files give no basis for it - see questionsForUser. The kit file's 'grounding' flag on Undertow contradicts Riot's own description of that ability; I trusted the description and removed the existing grounding sentence rather than building on it.
